source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952, p. 10 ("COUNTY COUNCILS: DOWN")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: returned unopposed: the only nomination for the division (Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952)

note: Triennial election of Down County Council. Polling took place on Thursday 5 June 1952 in the two contested divisions, Castlewellan and Newry; the other eighteen were returned unopposed (Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952; Irish News, 6-7 June 1952). Returned unopposed.
